verdict.rationale: Sketch documents a built-in, first-party MCP Server that lets AI clients such as ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch. Its AI page describes AI-client-driven tasks: recreating styles and pages from a repo, and sorting, renaming and aligning layers. Natural-language operation therefore works, but only through a separately supplied external AI client, with no native in-app command interface evidenced. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
Connect any MCP-compatible AI client you like to Sketch.
Point your AI client at a repo to recreate text styles, colors, UI components, and even entire pages inside Sketch.
Sort, rename, and align layers automatically.
